function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The groups are imbalanced on key confounders: customer_segment and age_group. Specifically, email users are more likely to be loyal or returning, and paid_search users are more likely to be new. Since loyalty and returning status are likely associated with higher conversion rates, the observed higher conversion rate in email may be due to these confounders, not the channel itself. To estimate a fair difference in conversion rates, we must adjust for these confounders. I will compute the difference in conversion rates using stratification by customer_segment and age_group, then average the stratum-specific differences to get a balanced estimate."}
